title: Vox Populi, Vox AI? Using Language Models to Estimate German Public Opinion

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM with detailed voter personas and comparing the aggregate distribution of its predicted vote choices against actual benchmark survey data (GLES) to identify the overestimation or underestimation of specific political parties.

Estimating multinomial regression models to compare how demographic variables (e.g., age, gender, education, income, regional residence) influence voting behavior in the LLM's predictions versus actual survey responses, and analyzing the demographic characteristics of personas for which the LLM fails to generate a valid prediction.
